item.title: The Trillion-Dollar Cluster: Compute, Power and the Grid
item.description: The binding constraint on the decade ahead is not algorithms but compute and the power to run it. Training the next frontier models will require gigawatt-scale data centers, an unprecedented build-out of the electricity grid, natural gas and nuclear generation, advanced cooling, and a semiconductor supply chain that can keep pace. Energy is the new oil; the AI build-out is fundamentally an industrial-power story.
